title: The next turn's scan could overlap the current turn's sort
body:
`construct` in `libsufr/src/build.rs` runs the turns in sequence: `gather` scans the text for one turn's partitions, then `sort_partitions` sorts them. The scan is memory-bound and the sort compute-bound, and on dna-1024.fa with the default budget the 13 scans are 3.1 s of a 9 s build.

## Proposal

Gather turn g+1 while turn g sorts, holding two turns in memory. The scan takes its threads from the sort, so the gain is bounded by how much of the scan the sort's memory stalls can hide; a measurement before a design.
